title: USDC Escrow
summary: Buyer and seller escrow with an arbiter
description: A buyer locks USDC for a seller; the buyer releases on delivery or the seller refunds. Either party can dispute before the deadline for a named arbiter to split, and undisputed deals return to the buyer after the deadline.
prompts: Hold USDC in escrow until the freelancer delivers
Build a marketplace where payment is released after delivery
Escrow with a dispute resolver for peer-to-peer trades
prerequisites: Native gas on the C-Chain for the signer
Three distinct wallets to exercise a deal end to end: buyer, seller, and arbiter

contracts.name: USDCEscrow
contracts.description: Deals with release, refund, dispute, settlement, and deadline reclaim

review: Each state-changing function checks both the caller's role and the deal's status before moving funds.
Status changes are written before tokens move, and every transfer path is nonReentrant.
The arbiter is chosen per deal and can only split a disputed deal; it can never redirect funds to itself.
Deadlines are unix seconds; the UI shows them in the user's timezone and warns before the dispute window closes.

frontend.summary: Hold USDC safely between a buyer and a seller until the deal is done, with a neutral arbiter for disputes.
audience: Buyers paying for work or goods
journeys: Start a deal: seller, amount, deadline and terms in plain words; the buyer funds it in two visible steps.
A deal page that says what's happening and whose turn it is ('Waiting for the buyer to release 500 USDC'), with only the actions that person can take.
My deals: every deal where I'm buyer, seller or arbiter, with the ones needing my action first.
Dispute: either side opens one; the arbiter splits the amount with a slider that shows both shares before signing.
After the deadline, a clear reclaim button for the buyer.
flows: Create: the buyer enters seller, arbiter, amount, deadline and terms, approves exactly the amount, then calls createDeal. Read the id from DealCreated.
Show actions by role and status: buyer may release or dispute; seller may refund or dispute; the arbiter may settle a disputed deal with a split; anyone may reclaim after the deadline.
List a wallet's deals from DealCreated events filtered by the indexed buyer or seller.
For settle, collect the seller's share as an amount and show the buyer's remainder before signing.
